reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-size sachet and the QR on every one. I fly twice a month and a sachet that goes in a bag with no bottle is useful, and a batch report I can check makes me trust it more than a random TikTok brand. About $1 a day is fine if I get it on a flash deal.
objection: 30 foil packets a month is a lot of trash, and I'm paying extra for packaging when a bottle would be cheaper per day.
would_change_my_mind: A flash-sale or coupon price near $24, or a lower price per day than a bottle of the same magnesium.
